title: Adventurous Aromatic Saudi Arabian Pork Belly Kebabs
description: A charred and springy Saudi Arabian dish featuring pork belly slices, this recipe is a unique and flavorful twist on traditional kebabs, with a deglaze-fond and no onion or garlic, making it friendly to those with sensitivities.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium high heat, making sure the grates are clean and brush them with oil to prevent sticking.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, Saudi Arabian spice mix, salt, and black pepper.
Add the sliced pork belly to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade, making sure each piece is well coated.
Thread the marinated pork belly pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 5-7 minutes per side, or until they are charred and cooked through to an internal temperature of 145 degrees.
While the kebabs are cooking, mix the pomegranate molasses and 1 tablespoon of water in a small bowl.
After flipping the kebabs, brush the pomegranate molasses mixture onto the cooked side of the kebabs.
Once the kebabs are done, remove them from the grill and brush with the deglaze-fond made by reducing the marinade over high heat until almost syrupy.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately.
